Northgate Weekly | Business

Ferndale Mill Finds New Life as a Design Hub
By Corinne Alsop

FERNDALE (March 8) — The former textile mill on Canal Street, empty since 2009, will reopen in September as a shared workplace for small design firms, developer Arlen Property Group announced on Tuesday.

The 40,000-square-foot building will be divided into twenty-eight studio units and will also house a woodshop, a photography stage, and a ground-floor café open to the public. Rents will start at $520 a month, well below the average of $890 charged for comparable space downtown.

"We deliberately kept the units small," said project director Naomi Petrosyan. "Most of the businesses we spoke with employ fewer than six people. What they lack is not floor area but equipment they could never buy on their own."

The project has not been without opposition. At a public hearing in January, several residents of the surrounding neighborhood argued that the added traffic would overwhelm Canal Street, which narrows to a single lane at its northern end. In response, Arlen agreed to pay for a shuttle service linking the site to the Ferndale rail station and to cap on-site parking at forty spaces.

Crews began removing old insulation in February, and interior work is scheduled to start in May. Ms. Petrosyan said that eleven units have already been reserved by firms currently working in temporary offices elsewhere in the county.

The Ferndale Merchants Association estimates that the café, together with clients visiting the studios, could bring several hundred additional shoppers to Canal Street each week.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: A dispute over a proposed rail line
The conversion of a vacant building into workspace
The closing of a textile manufacturer
A change to a city parking regulation
questions.explanation: 定位:第一段第一句「The former textile mill on Canal Street, empty since 2009, will reopen in September as a shared workplace for small design firms」,全文皆圍繞這棟舊紡織廠改建為設計工作空間。(A)錯:鐵路只在第四段以接駁車目的地出現,並非爭議焦點。(C)錯:工廠自 2009 年即已閒置,並非本則新聞的事件。(D)錯:停車位上限只是開發商對居民的讓步條件之一,非市府法規變更。

questions.q: According to Ms. Petrosyan, what will the site offer that tenants could not obtain on their own?
options: Membership in a merchants association
Rents that decrease each year
Equipment that small firms cannot afford individually
Long-term contracts with local clients
questions.explanation: 定位:第三段引言「What they lack is not floor area but equipment they could never buy on their own」,呼應第二段列出的木工房與攝影棚等共用設施。(A)錯:商家協會出現在最後一段,是估算來客數的單位,與租戶福利無關。(B)錯:文中只提租金起價 520 美元,未提逐年調降。(D)錯:文中未承諾為租戶帶來客戶合約。

questions.q: What did Arlen Property Group agree to do after the public hearing?
options: Fund transportation to a train station
Reduce the size of the building
Delay construction until September
Add more on-site parking spaces
questions.explanation: 定位:第四段末句「Arlen agreed to pay for a shuttle service linking the site to the Ferndale rail station」。(B)錯:文中未提縮減建物規模,坪數 40,000 平方英尺始終不變。(C)錯:九月是開幕時間,內部工程預定五月動工,並無延後之說。(D)錯:方向相反,開發商同意把基地內停車位限制在四十格。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the renovated building?
options: A café
A photography stage
A woodshop
A conference auditorium
questions.explanation: 定位:第二段「will also house a woodshop, a photography stage, and a ground-floor café open to the public」明列三項設施,故(A)(B)(C)皆有提及。全文未出現任何會議禮堂或大型演講廳,故(D)為未提及者。

translation:
北門週報｜商業版

芬戴爾舊紡織廠將重生為設計基地
柯琳・艾爾索普 撰

芬戴爾訊（三月八日）——開發商亞倫地產集團於週二宣布,運河街上那座自二○○九年起便閒置的舊紡織廠,將於九月重新開放,作為小型設計公司的共用工作空間。

這棟四萬平方英尺的建築將隔成二十八個工作室單位,另設木工房、攝影棚,以及一樓對外開放的咖啡館。租金起價每月五百二十美元,遠低於市中心同等空間平均八百九十美元的行情。

「我們是刻意把單位做小的,」專案總監娜歐蜜・佩特羅席恩表示。「我們接觸過的業者多半僱用不到六個人。他們缺的不是坪數,而是自己絕對買不起的設備。」

這項計畫並非全無反對聲音。一月的公聽會上,周邊社區數名居民主張,新增車流會讓運河街不堪負荷,該路北端縮減為單線道。亞倫地產因此同意出資開辦接駁車,連接基地與芬戴爾火車站,並將基地內停車位上限訂為四十格。

施工團隊二月已開始拆除舊隔熱材,內部工程預定五月動工。佩特羅席恩表示,已有十一個單位被本郡其他地方目前暫用臨時辦公室的公司預訂。

芬戴爾商家協會估計,咖啡館加上前來工作室洽公的客戶,每週可為運河街帶來數百名額外的來客。

Home | Our Venues | Equipment Rental | Rates | Contact Us

EQUIPMENT RENTAL — FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Lanternfield Events rents audiovisual and staging equipment to organizations throughout the Tri-County area, whether or not your event is held at one of our venues.

How do I place an order?
Complete the request form on this page at least ten business days before your event. A coordinator will call you within two working days to confirm availability and arrange a delivery window. Orders placed with less than ten business days' notice are accepted by telephone only and carry a rush fee of $75.

Is delivery included?
Delivery and pickup are free within twenty miles of our Fairmont Road warehouse. Beyond that distance, we charge $1.40 per mile each way. Our drivers will carry equipment into the room where it will be used, but they are not permitted to mount screens or speakers on walls or ceilings.

Can I operate the equipment myself?
Yes. Every order includes an illustrated setup guide. Clients hosting more than 150 guests, however, are strongly advised to hire a technician ($240 for a four-hour shift), since our larger sound systems take some practice to adjust properly.

What happens if something is damaged?
Report any fault by calling the number printed on your delivery receipt before your event ends. Items returned damaged are billed at replacement cost unless you have purchased the optional protection plan, which adds ten percent to the cost of the order.

questions.q: For whom is the webpage most likely intended?
options: Employees of Lanternfield Events
Manufacturers of audiovisual equipment
Contractors bidding on a construction project
People organizing events
questions.explanation: 定位:標題下第一段「Lanternfield Events rents audiovisual and staging equipment to organizations throughout the Tri-County area, whether or not your event is held at one of our venues」,通篇以「您的活動」為對象說明下訂、送貨與賠償規定。(A)錯:內容是對外的客戶須知,不是員工作業手冊。(B)錯:公司是出租方,不是向製造商採購。(C)錯:全文與工程招標無關。

questions.q: What is indicated about orders placed fewer than ten business days in advance?
options: They cannot be accepted.
They must be made by telephone.
They are limited to events of 150 guests or fewer.
They require the protection plan.
questions.explanation: 定位:「How do I place an order?」段末句「Orders placed with less than ten days' notice are accepted by telephone only and carry a rush fee of $75」。(A)錯:仍然受理,只是限電話並加收急件費。(C)錯:150 人是建議另聘技術人員的門檻,與下訂時間無關。(D)錯:保障方案是選購項目,與急件無關。

questions.q: What will the company's drivers NOT do?
options: Attach speakers to a wall
Carry items into the room where they will be used
Return to pick up the equipment
Provide a delivery receipt
questions.explanation: 定位:「Is delivery included?」段「they are not permitted to mount screens or speakers on walls or ceilings」,司機不得將喇叭或螢幕安裝在牆面與天花板。(B)錯:同段明說司機會把設備搬進使用的房間。(C)錯:同段開頭提到 delivery and pickup,即含收回。(D)錯:最後一段提到 delivery receipt 上印有回報電話,可見有送貨單。

questions.q: The word "carry" in the section "How do I place an order?" is closest in meaning to
options: transport
support
involve
extend
questions.explanation: 定位:「carry a rush fee of $75」中的 carry 意為「附帶、產生（費用）」,與 involve 最接近。(A)錯:transport（搬運）是同一頁下一段「drivers will carry equipment into the room」的用法,此處主詞是訂單而非人,不能搬運。(B)(D)錯:support（支撐）、extend（延長）皆無「附帶費用」之意。

translation:
www.lanternfieldevents.com/rentals

首頁｜場地介紹｜設備租賃｜費率｜聯絡我們

設備租賃－常見問題

蘭登菲活動公司為三郡地區的各類機構出租視聽與舞台設備,無論您的活動是否在本公司場地舉辦皆可承租。

如何下訂?
請於活動前至少十個工作天填妥本頁的申請表。專員會在兩個工作天內來電確認庫存並安排送貨時段。距活動不足十個工作天才提出的訂單僅接受電話受理,並須加收七十五美元的急件費。

含運嗎?
以費爾蒙路倉庫為中心二十英里內,送貨與收回免費。超出此範圍者,去回程各按每英里一點四美元計費。司機會將設備搬進使用的房間,但不得將螢幕或喇叭安裝於牆面或天花板。

我可以自己操作設備嗎?
可以。每筆訂單皆附圖解安裝說明。不過,賓客超過一百五十人的客戶,我們強烈建議另聘技術人員（四小時班次二百四十美元）,因為本公司較大型的音響設備需要一定的操作經驗才能調得恰當。

設備損壞怎麼辦?
請在活動結束前撥打送貨單上印的電話回報故障。歸還時已損壞的品項將按重置成本計價,除非您已購買選購的保障方案（費用為訂單金額加收一成）。

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Sales and Marketing Staff
FROM: Priya Rasmussen, Director of Finance
DATE: June 2
SUBJECT: Transition to the Voyance expense system

Beginning July 1, all travel and entertainment expenses must be submitted through Voyance, the online system we began testing with the Northeast sales team in March. Paper forms will no longer be processed after that date, and any paper claim received in July will be returned to the sender.

The trial produced two clear results. Reimbursements that once took an average of nineteen days now reach employees in six, and the number of claims sent back for missing documentation fell by roughly half. Much of that improvement comes from the mobile application, which lets you photograph a receipt at the moment of purchase instead of hunting for it weeks later.

A few points to note:

- Claims must be submitted within thirty days of the date an expense is incurred. This limit is not new, but Voyance enforces it automatically; late claims will require written approval from your department head.
- Receipts are required for every item over $25, meals included.
- Your manager will approve claims inside the system. You no longer need to obtain a signature before submitting a claim.

Training sessions lasting forty-five minutes will be held in Conference Room B on June 10, 12, and 17 at 9:00 A.M. Attendance is required for anyone who filed an expense claim during the past year. Please register through the link circulated by Human Resources; each session is capped at twenty-five participants.

Questions about the software itself should go to the help desk rather than to Finance.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a new procedure for submitting expenses
To remind staff of a spending limit
To introduce a newly hired finance director
To explain why some payments have been delayed
questions.explanation: 定位:第一段第一句「Beginning July 1, all travel and entertainment expenses must be submitted through Voyance」,後續說明期限、收據與教育訓練,全篇都在宣布報帳流程改制。(B)錯:文中只提 25 美元的收據門檻,不是消費上限提醒。(C)錯:拉斯穆森是發文者,無新任介紹。(D)錯:文中談的是核銷天數縮短,不是說明延遲。

questions.q: What is indicated about the trial of Voyance?
options: It was open only to managers.
It shortened the time needed to reimburse employees.
It was extended beyond its original schedule.
It required Finance to hire additional staff.
questions.explanation: 定位:第二段「Reimbursements that once took an average of nineteen days now reach employees in six」,核銷時間由十九天縮短為六天。(A)錯:第一段說試辦對象是東北區業務團隊,不是主管層級。(C)錯:文中未提試辦期延長。(D)錯:文中未提增聘人力,只提到問題請洽服務台。

questions.q: What are employees NO LONGER required to do?
options: Keep receipts for meals
Submit claims within thirty days
Obtain a signature before submitting a claim
Attend a training session
questions.explanation: 定位:條列第三點「Your manager will approve claims inside the system. You no longer need to obtain a signature before submitting a claim」。(A)錯:第二點明說超過 25 美元的品項含餐費都要收據。(B)錯:第一點指出三十天期限「is not new」且系統會自動控管。(D)錯:過去一年曾報帳者仍須參加訓練。

questions.q: Who must attend a training session?
options: All members of the Human Resources department
Employees hired within the past year
Department heads
Employees who submitted an expense claim in the past year
questions.explanation: 定位:倒數第二段「Attendance is required for anyone who filed an expense claim during the past year」。(A)錯:人資部只負責發送報名連結,且本備忘錄的收件對象是業務與行銷同仁,並未要求該部門受訓。(B)錯:條件是過去一年曾報帳,不是到職年資。(C)錯:部門主管只在逾期申請的書面同意中出現。

translation:
備忘錄

致:全體業務與行銷同仁
發文者:財務部主任 普莉雅・拉斯穆森
日期:六月二日
主旨:改用 Voyance 費用系統

自七月一日起,所有差旅與交際費用一律須透過 Voyance 線上系統提交;該系統自三月起由東北區業務團隊試用。該日之後不再受理紙本表單,七月收到的紙本申請一律退回原申請人。

試用結果有兩項明確成效。過去平均需十九天的核銷款項,如今六天即可入帳;因文件不全而被退件的申請則減少約半數。這多半得力於行動應用程式,讓各位可在消費當下拍下收據,不必事後幾週再翻找。

幾點提醒:

－ 申請須於費用發生日起三十天內提出。此期限並非新規定,但 Voyance 會自動控管;逾期申請須取得所屬部門主管的書面同意。
－ 單筆超過二十五美元的品項皆須檢附收據,餐費亦同。
－ 主管將直接在系統內核准申請。提交前不必再取得簽名。

教育訓練為期四十五分鐘,將於六月十日、十二日、十七日上午九時在 B 會議室舉行。過去一年內曾提出費用申請者一律必須參加。請透過人資部發送的連結報名;每場名額上限二十五人。

系統本身的問題請洽服務台,勿逕洽財務部。

HALVERSON INSTITUTE OF PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Fall Certificate Workshops — Kestrel Business Park Campus

Registration is now open for the workshops listed below. All sessions run from 9:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. and include lunch.

Managing Remote Teams — Friday, October 3 — $310
Negotiation for Purchasing Staff — Tuesday, October 14 — $340
Financial Reporting Essentials — Thursday, October 23 — $340
Presenting with Data — Saturday, November 8 — $290

Notes for participants:

- Organizations enrolling three or more employees in the same workshop receive a fifteen percent reduction on each registration.
- Fees must be paid no later than ten days before the workshop date. Registrations that remain unpaid after that point are released to the waiting list.
- Each workshop is limited to eighteen participants so that every attendee can take part in the afternoon practice exercises.
- Anyone who completes two workshops within a twelve-month period may apply the value of a third workshop toward our Certificate in Operations Management.
- Saturday sessions meet in the Willowbank Annex, a ten-minute walk from the main building. Parking at the Annex is limited, and we recommend the shuttle from Kestrel Station.

To register, contact Delia Ambrose at d.ambrose@halversoninstitute.org or 555-0142.

To: Delia Ambrose <d.ambrose@halversoninstitute.org>
From: Marcus Tiley <m.tiley@brightwaterdairy.com>
Date: September 12
Subject: Fall workshops

Dear Ms. Ambrose,

I saw your notice at the Kestrel Business Park reception desk and would like to enroll four members of my purchasing department in the session you are offering for that group. Could you confirm that places are still available and tell me the total cost once the group reduction has been applied?

Two further questions. First, one of my colleagues, Renata Voss, attended a workshop with you last November and another this past March. Would she be able to put the value of a third workshop toward the certificate you mention, or has too much time passed?

Second, I would also like to send two staff members to the November session. None of them drives, so could you tell me how often the shuttle you refer to runs on weekends?

Finally, we would prefer to settle the invoice by bank transfer. Our accounts department processes transfers on the last working day of each month, and I hope that will still leave us inside your payment window.

Kind regards,

Marcus Tiley
Purchasing Manager
Brightwater Dairy

questions.q: According to the notice, why is the number of participants in each workshop limited?
options: The rooms in the Annex are small.
Lunch must be ordered well in advance.
Everyone must be able to join the afternoon exercises.
The instructors are available only part-time.
questions.explanation: 定位:公告注意事項第三點「Each workshop is limited to eighteen participants so that every attendee can take part in the afternoon practice exercises」,so that 直接點出理由。(A)錯:別館提到的限制是停車位,不是教室大小。(B)錯:公告只說含午餐,未提訂餐時程。(D)錯:全文未提講師的工作型態。

questions.q: Why did Mr. Tiley write the e-mail?
options: To request a refund for a canceled session
To suggest a new workshop topic
To report a problem with parking
To ask about enrolling a group of employees
questions.explanation: 定位:電子郵件第一段「would like to enroll four members of my purchasing department... Could you confirm that places are still available」,後續各段都是報名衍生的問題。(A)錯:尚未報名,更無取消退費。(B)錯:他是選現有課程,未提議新主題。(C)錯:他只問接駁車班次,並未抱怨停車。

questions.q: How much will Brightwater Dairy most likely pay for each of the four registrations?
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。電子郵件第一段說要替採購部門四人報名「the session you are offering for that group」,對照公告課程表即 Negotiation for Purchasing Staff,原價 340 美元;公告注意事項第一點規定同一場次三人以上每個名額打八五折,340 × 0.85 = 289。(A)錯:263.50 是誤用 310 美元的 Managing Remote Teams 計算。(C)錯:310 美元是另一門課的原價。(D)錯:340 美元是未套用團體折扣的原價。

questions.q: Where will the two additional employees mentioned by Mr. Tiley most likely attend their workshop?
options: In the Willowbank Annex
In the main building
At Brightwater Dairy
At Kestrel Station
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。電子郵件第三段說要再派兩人參加「the November session」;公告課程表顯示十一月唯一場次是十一月八日星期六的 Presenting with Data,而注意事項第五點規定「Saturday sessions meet in the Willowbank Annex」。(B)錯:主建築是平日場次的地點。(C)錯:課程在學院校區舉辦,不在客戶公司。(D)錯:凱斯楚車站只是搭接駁車的起點。

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Voss?
options: She works in the accounts department.
She has already received the Certificate in Operations Management.
She is eligible to apply a third workshop toward a certificate.
She must wait until next year to register again.
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。電子郵件第二段說她去年十一月與今年三月各上過一場;公告注意事項第四點規定十二個月內完成兩場即可將第三場費用抵充 Certificate in Operations Management,兩次相隔僅約四個月,符合條件。(A)錯:帳務部門是處理匯款的單位,與她的職務無關。(B)錯:她尚未上第三場,證書尚未取得。(D)錯:兩份文件都沒有等待期的規定。

哈佛森職能發展學院
秋季證書工作坊－凱斯楚商業園區校區

下列工作坊即日起開放報名。所有場次皆自上午九時進行至下午四時,並含午餐。

遠距團隊管理－十月三日（星期五）－三一○美元
採購人員談判技巧－十月十四日（星期二）－三四○美元
財務報表基礎－十月二十三日（星期四）－三四○美元
以數據做簡報－十一月八日（星期六）－二九○美元

參加者須知:

－ 費用最遲須於工作坊日期前十天繳清。逾期未繳者,其名額將釋出給候補名單。

To: travel@pellworthgray.com
From: i.sato@pellworthgray.com
Date: April 1
Subject: Trip reference PG-40718 — two changes

Hello,

Two things have come up since the itinerary was issued.

First, Owen Achebe has asked whether the budget planning session could be moved to Tuesday morning, since his finance team is being audited on Wednesday. The suppliers are willing to meet me on Wednesday instead, but only in the afternoon, which means I would have to leave Larkspur later than planned. The next flight I can find departs at 18:05. Could you check whether that change still falls inside the free change window?

Second, the presentation on Tuesday has grown from twelve attendees to about thirty, and the room currently reserved seats twenty. Could you ask the hotel whether the Kingsley Room on the ground floor is available that afternoon? If it is not, I would rather move the session to the distribution center, which has a training room of the right size.

One last point: because I will now be in the city for an extra afternoon, please confirm that the hotel will not bill me for a late checkout.

Thank you,

Ingrid Sato

questions.explanation: 定位:行程表 Notes 段「meals other than Tuesday's dinner should be submitted as expenses」,除週二晚宴外的餐費一律走費用核銷。(A)錯:同段只說房費由公司直接支付,未含餐費。(B)錯:阿契貝先生是參訪與會議的接待人,文中未說他請客。(D)錯:配送中心是參訪與開會地點,未提供餐飲。

questions.q: Why did Ms. Sato write the e-mail?
options: To request changes to her trip arrangements
To decline an invitation to a dinner
To recommend a different hotel
To report a canceled flight
questions.explanation: 定位:主旨列「two changes」,第一段「Two things have come up since the itinerary was issued」,後續分別要求改航班與換會議室。(B)錯:她未提及要推掉週二晚宴。(C)錯:她只請櫃檯代問飯店會議室,並未建議換飯店。(D)錯:航班並未被取消,是她主動要求改期。

questions.q: If Ms. Sato's first request is approved, what will she do on the morning of Tuesday, April 7?
options: Tour the distribution center
Discuss budget planning with Mr. Achebe
Meet with suppliers
Present to regional managers
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。行程表原訂週二上午 09:00-12:00 為供應商檢討會議、週三上午 09:30-11:00 為預算規劃會議;電子郵件第二段請求把預算規劃會議移到週二上午,供應商則改到週三下午。兩相對照,週二上午將改為與阿契貝先生的預算規劃會議。(A)錯:配送中心參訪在週一下午。(C)錯:供應商會議依請求已挪到週三下午。(D)錯:對區域經理簡報排在週二下午 13:30。

questions.q: What is suggested about the change to Ms. Sato's return flight?
options: It must be approved by Mr. Achebe.
It will cause her to miss the budget session.
It cannot be made under the corporate fare.
It can be made without an additional charge.
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。行程表 Notes 說企業票價可免費更改一次,但須於起飛前至少七十二小時提出;電子郵件日期為四月一日,回程班機為四月八日,相隔遠超過七十二小時,故符合免費更改條件。(A)錯:阿契貝先生負責的是會議安排,機票由差旅櫃檯處理。(B)錯:預算會議依請求提前到週二,不受影響。(C)錯:Notes 明言企業票價可更改一次。

questions.q: What is the problem with the Emerson Room?
options: It is too small for the expected audience.
It is located on the ground floor.
It is being renovated.
It has been reserved by another group.
questions.explanation: 定位:須整合兩篇。行程表顯示週二 13:30-15:00 對區域經理的簡報安排在 Hartfield Suites 的 Emerson Room;電子郵件第三段說出席人數已由十二人增至約三十人,而「the room currently reserved seats twenty」,可知該廳容納不下。(B)錯:位於一樓的是她想改訂的 Kingsley Room。(C)(D)錯:兩份文件皆未提整修或被其他團體預訂。
